question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 2.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **agile**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given words.
 
 
• Alive means living; having life; not dead. (सजीव; जीवन होना; मरा नहीं)
 
• Alike means in the same manner, form, or degree: equally. (उसी तरह, रूप, या डिग्री: समान रूप से)
 
• Awake means to arouse from sleep: wake up. (नींद से जगाना : जागो)
 
• **Agile **means being able to move quickly and easily. (जल्दी और आसानी से स्थानांतरित करने में सक्षम)
 
 
 
• The "Agile hunter" means easily flexible to track the hunt.
 
• So, as per the meaning of the given words, "agile" should be used in the given sentence.

Therefore, the correct answer is option 4.

Complete passage: *The Small Indian Mongoose, (1) with __its little round ears, is an **__(2) agile __**hunter and has a long snout-like face and short legs that have sharp claws. It (3) ______ brown or grey-grizzly fur and (4) ______ in abandoned burrows or tunnels. (5) ______ the rat-like appearance, mongooses are not rodents.*

4b:Tccd,

The correct answer is: has
